prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG walking sprite sheet, genuine transparent PNG. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the detailed charming pixel art, dark outlines, clustered pixel shading and body proportions of the attached adventurer, but make a completely different character. EXACT layout: 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate full-body poses, equal square cells with generous completely transparent gutters and no labels or gridlines. Rows in order: FRONT facing down, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, BACK facing up. In EACH row columns: standing idle, left leg forward walking, feet passing walking, right leg forward walking. Same character identity, size, hat/face/body, height, grounded baseline in every cell. Only legs and arms vary with walking. Each sprite fully contained, no overlapping cells, no cutoffs. Orthographic slightly top-down classic 2D adventure game, visible face in front row, clearly back of head in back row. Crisply pixelated, detailed but readable at 40 pixel displayed height. No scene, floor, text, props outside figure, cast floor shadows, gradients, blur, duplicate rows or perspective sheets. Character: a friendly island farmer with a golden straw hat, warm small brown beard, cream shirt, leafy green vest, brown overalls and sturdy brown boots. Broad straw brim and round welcoming face. Earthy natural island palette. Empty hands, no large tools.
